messages.content: We need to discuss our contract renewal. The current pricing is too high for what we're getting.
I understand. Let me pull up your usage data. You're currently on the Enterprise plan at $5,000/month.
We only use about 30% of the features. Can we downgrade?
We could move you to the Business plan at $2,500/month, but you'd lose SSO and the dedicated support channel.
We need SSO. What about a custom plan?
Let me get our account manager involved. We can discuss a tailored package.
Hi Björn, following up on our pricing discussion. We've put together a custom plan: Enterprise features at $3,800/month with a 2-year commitment.
That's still high. Our competitor quoted us $2,800 for similar features. We've been loyal customers for 2 years.
I appreciate your loyalty. Let me see what else we can do. Would $3,200/month with priority support included work?
Make it $3,000 and you have a deal.
Done. I'll send the updated contract today.
Great, thanks for working with us on this.
